item.title: Baltimore launches Asset Explorer to help residents find nearby parks and rec centers
item.description: Baltimore City Rec and Parks launches new Asset Explorer tool with YouTube tutorials to help residents easily locate green spaces, trails, and recreational facilities.

item.title: Johns Hopkins women's basketball eyes historic undefeated season with conference title in sight
item.description: Johns Hopkins Blue Jays women's basketball team stands 22-0 and ranked No. 3 nationally, extending their winning streak to 34 games while chasing program history.

item.title: Baltimore County Council votes to ban ICE detention centers
item.description: Baltimore County Council bans ICE detention centers after community concerns over federal office lease in Hunt Valley. Emergency session draws packed house of residents.
